All 12 physical pages have supplied earlier API text/image review coverage. This synthesis read complete supplied text and attributed image-review notes, not image pixels directly.
Source hash, page-call receipts and local path were supplied, not recomputed or independently authenticated.
No repository, code, data download, trained weights, external cited full text or additional supplements were inspected or executed.
No executable schema, source-match, semantic or graph validation, filesystem save or KG admission was performed in this call.
Core membership is implemented history-based health-world prediction; full recursive socioeconomic-state propagation and latent successor transitions remain unresolved.
Dataset geography reports 48 states, whereas cross-state testing reports 40 training and 9 unseen states. Introductory feature-count wording differs from C=12 total channels.
CDC WONDER versus provisional-data source identity, mortality aggregation, normalization, release lag, missingness and monthly harmonization are unresolved.
Exact temporal split boundaries, sliding-window separation, train-only preprocessing and held-out-state graph/KG/codebook exposure are insufficiently documented.
Masked/next-token training claims are unreconciled with the detailed parallel prediction head and outcome-plus-VQ objective.
Tensor dimensions, central-node self-feature handling, codebook size, temperature, commitment weight, extraction prompts and extraction fidelity are incompletely reported.
Table 2 ± type and error aggregation/normalization are unspecified; descriptive mean rankings do not establish statistical significance.
Six months is maximum evaluated block extent, not an accepted effective horizon, recursive drift test or calibrated trajectory guarantee.
TN H 215 dates/identity conflict; later-dated policies are used in earlier hypothetical windows. Case-specific holdout status and pre-window policy advancement are unresolved.
MCTS searches and scores with the same predictor. No independent policy value, exploitation stress test, legal/cost feasibility or policy-pair synergy test is established.
R2 refers only to stated held-out actual retrospective aggregate human-outcome forecasting. R1 refers separately to in-silico technical search. R3 is partial, and R4–R8 are not established.
